abstract.title: Sentinel-GL: Source-Bound Retrospective Development Diagnostics for Two Glacial-Lake Regions
abstract.abstract: We report source-bound retrospective development diagnostics for South Lhonak and an NRSC-referenced Khangchung Tsho region using 48 Sentinel-2 observations from 2023. The source manifest also records 1 Sentinel-1 date; it is used only as acquisition context. A 1,062,919-parameter temporal masked autoencoder was fit with quadrant-level target masking and 5 optimizer seeds. There are 191 estimated and 9 unavailable query quadrants per seed. Acquisition-level medians describe reconstruction and latent-distance scores before and after the protocol's event-phase boundary. A reflectance-only companion measures representation sensitivity, and an optical robust-PCA run records its numerical solver status. The full pre-period informed model fitting, the two regions are not independent event samples, and their grids are not validated lake polygons. These outputs do not estimate water area, event-detection performance, causal effects, precursor skill, or operational warning reliability.
abstract.keywords: retrospective analysis, Sentinel-2, masked autoencoders, source audit

blocks.text: 1. Introduction

Glacial-lake expansion and downstream exposure motivate transparent satellite analyses [[cite:shugar2020,zheng2021,taylor2023]]. The October 2023 South Lhonak cascade is documented by [[cite:sattar2025]]. We ask which source-supported reconstruction and fitted anomaly summaries arise under explicit sensor missingness and fitting scope. Khangchung is a development comparator with unverified non-event history, not an independent negative label.
2. Literature

Temporal masked reconstruction [[cite:li2023]] and memory-guided input/latent scoring [[cite:song2023]] provide close prior methods. Same-event InSAR/optical work [[cite:yu2024]] provides context; no SAR-derived result is asserted here. Historical Landsat inventories [[cite:veh2018]] support change methodology, not the 2023 breach attribution.
3. Methods and Procedures

The corrected Khangchung reference is 27.988333° N, 88.815000° E [[cite:nrsc2025]]. Native-aligned 499×499 grids use 20-m EPSG:32645 pixels. The specified comparator grid center is 138.5 m from the reference, which lies inside its bounds. The ROIs are not validated lake polygons.

There are 50 site–sensor observations from 49 provider products, including 48 optical observations. The manifest records 1 Sentinel-1 date as inventory context; no SAR measurement or fusion result is interpreted. Optical baselines comprise 48 granules at ESA Processing Baseline 05.09. The retained source packet binds granule metadata and byte-range receipts [[cite:s2technical,earthsearch]]. SCL 4/5/6 and source-band masks retain missingness. Band ratios require finite nonzero denominators and are not clipped; values may fall outside [−1,1]. Candidate spectral masks are not validated shorelines.

The cutoff is 2 October 2023, 18:30 UTC (3 October 00:00 IST in Sikkim; 00:15 NPT). Parity-0 normalization, fitting and reference states use pre-cutoff support; parity 1 monitors those same scenes. A 1,062,919-parameter quadrant-masked autoencoder hides all query-quadrant channels and uses causal input prefixes, with 5 optimization seeds. Isolation Forest, One-Class SVM and optical robust PCA provide descriptive comparisons. CUSUM is computed from Isolation Forest scores and is not an independent detector.

A separate 160 × 160 implementation is excluded from numerical comparison. Code inspection found a different water classifier and denominator formula than the stated rule, and found that its scaler and latent reference fit include the final two nominal validation scenes per region. Its filename-derived acquisition times also differ from source-manifest times for all 48 scenes, so event delays are not interpreted. Since spatial extent and method changed together, no factorial effect of spatial pooling is estimated.

blocks.caption: Figure 1. Optical clear fractions and the retained SAR acquisition date. Shading follows the frozen protocol interval and does not independently establish event timing; optical gaps remain missing. Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data [2023], processed by the author.

blocks.text: 4. Results

There are 191 estimated and 9 unavailable query quadrants per seed and 950 score-ledger rows. Selected development losses range from 0.206412 to 0.311731. Optical RPCA reports CONVERGED, 160 iterations and rank 3. South Lhonak reconstruction medians change from 0.0487 to 0.0551; comparator medians change from 0.0897 to 0.0472. Latent medians change from 1.5573 to 2.0114 and 1.9787 to 3.7171, respectively. These are within-method descriptive associations.

blocks.caption: Figure 2. Source-supported South Lhonak optical images and empirical distributions. Invalid pixels are masked; spectral masks are not validated shorelines. Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data [2023], processed by the author.

blocks.text: NDWI: 598 of 2001002 fitting pixels (0.0299%) lie outside [−1,1], contributing 98.53% of squared deviations about the fitted mean. MNDWI: 647 of 2001003 fitting pixels (0.0323%) lie outside [−1,1], contributing 48.74% of squared deviations about the fitted mean.

The separately fitted reflectance-only companion excludes NDWI/MNDWI inputs and targets under the same seed/budget rule. South Lhonak shared raw-band residuals: primary 0.0778 to 0.0874; companion 0.0817 to 0.0807. Khangchung Tsho shared raw-band residuals: primary 0.1408 to 0.0650; companion 0.1419 to 0.0737. Acquisition medians use matched support after seed medians. Primary observations were not clipped or replaced.
5. Interpretation and Limitations

Whole-region pooling mixes surfaces, terrain and changing seasonal QA support; these factors were not isolated as causes. The full pre-period informed fitted parameters, so early trajectories are development-exposed. Checkerboard parity, acquisitions and seeds are dependent rather than independent event samples. The corpus has 1 SAR date and unverified comparator non-event history. Independent event/control cohorts, validated lake masks, historical availability and annual exposure are absent. No water area, causal attribution, calibrated warning performance, operational lead time or broad precursor conclusion follows. Local execution is not clean-platform or independent scientific replication.
6. Conclusion

The corrected source-bound analysis supplies measured retrospective diagnostics with explicit missingness and representation sensitivity. Authenticated lake masks, independent cohorts, verified exposure and prospective validation are needed before warning claims.

fullpaper.keywords: retrospective analysis, Sentinel-2, masked autoencoders, source audit

blocks.text: 1. Introduction

Glacial-lake expansion and downstream exposure motivate transparent satellite analyses [[cite:shugar2020,zheng2021,taylor2023]]. The October 2023 South Lhonak cascade is documented by [[cite:sattar2025]]. We ask which source-supported reconstruction and fitted anomaly summaries arise under explicit sensor missingness and fitting scope. Khangchung is a development comparator with unverified non-event history, not an independent negative label.
2. Literature

Historical Landsat inventories support GLOF change assessment [[cite:veh2018]]; that citation does not document the 2023 breach. Sentinel-2 optical reflectance [[cite:drusch2012]] supports NDWI and MNDWI [[cite:mcfeeters1996,xu2006]]. Prior Sentinel-1 and InSAR studies provide remote-sensing context [[cite:torres2012,yu2024]], but no SAR-derived result is asserted here.

Transformers and masked autoencoders provide contextual representations [[cite:vaswani2017,zerveas2021,he2022]]. Ti-MAE masks embedded temporal data and reconstructs point-level inputs [[cite:li2023]]. MEMTO combines a memory-guided transformer with input- and latent-space deviation [[cite:song2023]]. Our dependency closure, source accounting and bounded satellite application do not constitute a novel general transformer architecture. Unsupervised anomaly comparisons require explicit support and careful evaluation [[cite:sarfraz2024]].
3. Methods and Procedures
3.1. Regions and source observations

The Khangchung reference is 27.988333° N, 88.815000° E [[cite:nrsc2025]]. The corrected native-aligned EPSG:32645 grid has shape 499×499, 20-m pixels and affine [20, 0, 673540, 0, -20, 3102360]. Its side is 9.98 km and area 99.6004 km². The specified grid center is 138.5 m from the reference point, which lies inside the grid. South Lhonak retains affine [20, 0, 613480, 0, -20, 3093360]. Reference-point coverage was checked against the source grid. Neither ROI is an authenticated lake polygon, and full-lake coverage or pixel registration is not established. The prior off-center data epoch remains preserved and is not used as the corrected comparator.

The corpus contains 50 site–sensor observations from 49 unique provider products, with 24 optical observations at South Lhonak and 24 at Khangchung. Retained products were selected score-blind by temporal bins, scene cloud metadata and deterministic tie-breaking. Observed optical processing baselines are 48 granules at ESA Processing Baseline 05.09. The validator checks baseline identity, native BOA quantification/offset tags and STAC/COG scale/offset declarations per granule [[cite:s2technical,earthsearch]]. Exact HTTP 206 ranges bind source windows; they do not authenticate an entire undownloaded COG. SCL classes 4/5/6 and source-band support determine validity. Band ratios require finite nonzero denominators; signed reflectance may yield indices outside [−1,1]. Missing source values remain unavailable, and candidate spectral masks are not validated shorelines.

The manifest records 1 Sentinel-1 acquisition date: 2023-09-01. This is acquisition-inventory context only. We do not interpret SAR calibration, backscatter change, terrain registration, or SAR fusion in this analysis.

blocks.caption: Figure 1. Optical clear fractions and the retained SAR acquisition date. Shading follows the frozen protocol interval and does not independently establish event timing; optical gaps remain missing. Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data [2023], processed by the author.

Figure 2. Source-supported South Lhonak optical images and empirical distributions. Invalid pixels are masked; spectral masks are not validated shorelines. Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data [2023], processed by the author.

blocks.text: 3.2. Fitting scope and masked model

The fitting cutoff is 2 October 2023, 18:30 UTC (3 October 00:00 IST in Sikkim; 00:15 NPT). The frozen protocol labels an onset-uncertain bracket of [2023-10-02T18:30:00Z, 2023-10-04T18:30:00Z); this analysis does not independently establish event timing. Verified support ends must precede the cutoff. Parity 0 supplies fitting pixels and parity 1 monitors the same pre-breach scenes; 43 observations are fitting members and 43 supply usable training examples. Welford moments [[cite:welford1962]] use fitting support only. Per-query input contexts contain same-site acquisitions no later than the query, while fitted parameters use the entire pre-period. Early trajectories are consequently development-exposed retrospective reconstructions.

Each asynchronous acquisition yields quadrant tokens containing normalized observed channel means, presence masks, modality, quadrant and elapsed/calendar time. Each target quadrant is hidden in all channels before reconstruction; derived indices cannot reveal a hidden band through the same token. Empty targets or absent visible context yield explicit unavailable records. The encoder has 4 layers and the decoder 2, width 128, and 4 attention heads. The model has 1,062,919 trainable parameters. AdamW [[cite:loshchilov2019]] uses learning rate 0.0003, weight decay 0.0001, 2 warmup epochs, gradient clipping 1, minimum/earliest selection epoch 12/12, maximum 80 epochs, patience 12 and tolerance 0.0001. Seeds are 0, 1, 2, 3, 4. Selection minimizes parity-1 pre-period masked MSE; patience or budget exhaustion is not proof of global convergence.
3.3. Scores and comparisons

Score A is mean supported masked squared error. Score B averages nearest-neighbor distance after fitting-only latent PCA, excluding same-product and same-sensor-arrival reference rows. Each reference-acquisition distance is the minimum over its quadrant embeddings; the nearest distinct acquisitions are then averaged per query quadrant. Score C combines fitting-only standardized A/B with the fixed equal weight. Recorded optical latent PCA rank(s) are 8; neighbor k values are 5. Isolation Forest [[cite:liu2008]], One-Class SVM [[cite:scholkopf2001]], robust PCA [[cite:candes2009,lin2010]] and CUSUM [[cite:page1954]] provide simple comparisons. Baselines are sensor-stratified; absent channels are not observed zeros. CUSUM consumes Isolation Forest scores and is not an independent drainage measurement. Calibrating an operational false-alarm rate per lake-year via Peaks-Over-Threshold theory [[cite:pickands1975,davison1990]] requires a defensible tail sample and verified exposure schedule, which are unavailable here.

A separate 160 × 160 implementation is excluded from numerical comparison. Code inspection found a different water classifier and denominator formula than the stated rule, and found that its scaler and latent reference fit include the final two nominal validation scenes per region. Its filename-derived acquisition times also differ from source-manifest times for all 48 scenes, so event delays are not interpreted. Since spatial extent and method changed together, no factorial effect of spatial pooling is estimated.
4. Results

South Lhonak optical clear fractions range from 1.27% to 66.46% (median 41.17%); 0 acquisitions have no optical target support. Khangchung Tsho optical clear fractions range from 0.03% to 79.50% (median 59.25%); 0 acquisitions have no optical target support.

Seed variation reflects optimization conditional on this corpus. Table 2 records actual stopping and selection; no successful status is inferred from a fixed epoch count.

September latent medians are 2.6088 and 4.6989. These values and baseline changes are temporal associations within each method's units. They do not isolate a drainage effect. CUSUM's dependence on Isolation Forest and the comparator's unverified history preclude independent causal corroboration.

This is a numerical solver outcome on the available matrix, not evidence of physical validity. Nonconvergence and unestimable scores remain reportable statuses. Annual thresholds, AUROC, precision–recall and warning lead time remain unavailable.

blocks.text: 4.1. Index tail and representation sensitivity

NDWI: 598 of 2001002 fitting pixels (0.0299%) lie outside [−1,1], contributing 98.53% of squared deviations about the fitted mean. MNDWI: 647 of 2001003 fitting pixels (0.0323%) lie outside [−1,1], contributing 48.74% of squared deviations about the fitted mean.

The separately retrained reflectance-only companion removes NDWI/MNDWI inputs, presence indicators and loss targets, retaining the same architecture, seed set, budget and stopping rule. Shared B03/B08/B11 residual components use the same primary fitted units. South Lhonak: primary raw-band median residual 0.0778 to 0.0874; reflectance-only companion 0.0817 to 0.0807. Khangchung Tsho: primary raw-band median residual 0.1408 to 0.0650; reflectance-only companion 0.1419 to 0.0737. Each contrast uses matched seed/acquisition support, seed medians and then acquisition medians. Differently dimensioned total objectives are not treated as directly comparable detection performance. Primary data and index values were not clipped or replaced.

blocks.caption: Figure 5. Head-averaged encoder/decoder attention from the selected seed-0 checkpoint. The query and causal token order are bound in the figure metadata; attention is not causal attribution.

blocks.text: 5. Interpretation and Limitations

These are whole-ROI retrospective development summaries. Full pre-period parameter exposure means early queries are not prospective validation. Checkerboard parity shares scenes and environmental conditions; acquisitions, pixels and optimizer seeds do not create independent lakes or events. Neither a rise nor an absent spike establishes a precursor, a drainage cause or a general negative finding about satellite anomaly models.

Spatial pooling mixes potential lake surfaces, terrain and changing seasonal QA support. Those components were not independently isolated, so they remain possible explanations rather than demonstrated causes. Corrected reference-point coverage does not establish a validated shoreline or pixelwise lake correspondence. Comparator non-event history and the number of independent physical supports remain unresolved.

The corpus has 1 SAR acquisition date, which is not used for a SAR measurement claim. Index-tail diagnostics and the declared representation companion quantify a sensitivity without selecting a favorable replacement for the primary analysis.

Independent event/control cohorts, verified annual exposure and historical provider availability are absent. No operational threshold, calibrated annual false-alarm burden, causal effect, warning lead time or geographical generalization is estimable. Attention weights describe an internal computation, not causal importance. Local tests and replay support their specific contracts; clean-platform replication and independent domain review remain future work.
6. Conclusion

The corrected source-bound corpus supports 5 executed seed fits and transparent descriptive score contrasts. Reconstruction and latent trajectories are reported in Table 3 without treating them as validated warning skill. The measured index tail and independently fitted representation companion make representation dependence inspectable. Broader precursor or operational claims require authenticated lake masks, independent cohorts, exposure and prospective evaluation.
Data and code availability

A versioned result packet binds source manifests, native receipts, fitted states, scores, figures and sensitivity outputs by SHA-256. Full arrays, range receipts and checkpoints are retained locally and are not bundled with the prepared code/fixture snapshot. Sentinel source products and metadata are identified by their provider records. This is partial reproducibility: independent source-data reconstruction and a clean installation elsewhere have not been demonstrated. Existing code-license terms and upstream data rights remain distinct; source visibility does not grant a new software license.
